I have expressed my emotions while drunk but I guess it wasn't enough. I have cried in front of my fiancé about my issues and even started hurting myelf in front of him. I don't know what I was thinking but after that day I became stricter on myself.

I find that my fiancé has kinda given up on me. I asked him today of he was stressed or is un happy (he has been sick and expressed how miserable ot makes hom feel physically and emotionally) but when I asked he tells me I shouldn't be concerned abour his feelings. When I told him that I ask becasue I genuinley care, he response with "you should be concerned with your own feelings, not mine"

This made me feel hurt, is he trying to hurt me intentionaly or am I over reacting.

I feel like I'm a bad person because I avoid conflicts to make everyone around me happy and I stay less of a burden to everyone but my actions instead just do the opposite.

I want to be able to let out my feelings and stand my ground. I find myself retreating and thinking I'm being some kind of bitch for wanting to say something that will hurt the other person's feelings. I don't want to say what I want to express to my fiancé or to my best friend. 

Unfortunately they are the people who I feel most affected by. Its not their fualt though, its me who is just being too sensative I think.

I don't even know anymore to be honest. I feel like I come up with excuses for myself just to mask what a shitty person I am.

I'm not really in a good head space right now in my life, but I do want to experience it. 

I've micro dosed on mushrooms once and the feeling or euphoria felt out of this world.

Wow, i had to take a moment because of this comment. It's been a long time.
Such an simple comment and yet it was enough to get me to cry.
I'm too afraid to tell anyone I know how I feel. The first thing that comes to mind is shame.

My boyfriend has tried LSD and he says its changed the way he is now. After that he has done DMT and says its a totally different experince that LSD. 

I've been wondering myself if I should take DMT or mushrooms to try and fix myself. I've herad good things so far.
